name: mscse-4plus1-thesis-course-counts
description: DGS 2026-10-03 (P1-units-4plus1-17: “pre-bachelor 68901/68902 can be used to satisfy MSCSE thesis/project requirements”), reversing the 2026-09-12 reading of §3.4’s “earned at Notre Dame” as “while enrolled”: a 4+1 student’s undergraduate CSE 68901 (M.S. Thesis Direction, registered GR on the transcript) counts toward the six project/thesis credits — never toward the 24, and never as one of §3.5’s shared pair, which takes regular courses only (the undergraduate CSE 60641 draws that as usual). Registered UG, or typed with no level, it would wait for the ADGS to confirm the UG→GR move like any other pre-bachelor’s 60000-level course. (Until 2026-10-03 this fixture, as mscse-4plus1-research-course-not-shared, asserted the refusal.)

detailIncludes: 3 of the 6 credits shared with your bachelor’s degree used

CSE 68901: counts toward the project/thesis requirement (3 cr)
will apply to your MSCSE only
